brief:
Médecins Sans Frontières warned Wednesday that Israel is progressively restricting the space available to Palestinians in Gaza while survival conditions deteriorate, Palestine News Network reported. The humanitarian organization issued the alert as the enclave faces ongoing constraints on territory and resources.

Aid organizations have raised escalating concerns about the humanitarian situation in Gaza as Palestinians face diminishing access to livable space and basic necessities for survival.
dek: AMMAN, Jordan / JERUSALEM — Médecins Sans Frontières, or Doctors Without Borders, warned Wednesday that Israel is progressively restricting the space available to Palestinians in the Gaza Strip while conditions needed for survival continue to deteriorate amid…
title: Doctors Without Borders warns Gaza shrinkage threatens Palestinian survival
